name: sassc-rails → dartsass-sprockets (+ uglifier → terser)
deployed: core-iac #347 (17:46 UTC) set -909 in development, staging and production tfvars and helm values; staging applied ~17:50 UTC with smoke 49/0/2 before and after. Asset check on staging: application.css 158 KB (was 151 KB; now starts with a UTF-8 BOM from Dart Sass, Bootstrap 4.6.2 inline, font-face URLs digested), application.js 2.65 MB via terser (was 2.66 MB via uglifier), landing_page.js and logo.png digests unchanged. Production followed at ~17:55 UTC after the Terraform Cloud confirm, smoke 49/0/2 before and after. -909 is the baseline for attributing any Dart Sass / terser asset regression

changes.sassc: 2.4.0 removed (transitive; compiled libsass from C++ on every bundle install, ~26 s wall on an arm64 Mac for that one gem)
changes.dartsass_sprockets: added `~> 3.2`, locked 3.2.1 (Ruby >= 3.1; fork of sassc-rails, same `SassC` namespace, same Sprockets helper functions — font-url('Oswald-Regular.ttf') in _bootstrap-customization.scss still resolves to the digested /assets/ path)
changes.sass_embedded: new transitive 1.102.0 = Dart Sass 1.102.0 (see held_back for why not 1.106.x)
changes.google_protobuf: new transitive 4.35.1 (sass-embedded ~> 4.31); locked with aarch64-linux-gnu and x86_64-linux-gnu variants plus the generic entry
changes.sprockets: 4.2.2 → 4.4.1 (same major; moved during `bundle install`, `bundle update sprockets --conservative` confirmed it); sprockets-rails 3.5.2 unchanged
changes.production_rb: config.assets.js_compressor = Uglifier.new(harmony: true) → :terser; css_compressor stays commented (dartsass-sprockets, like sassc-rails, defaults it to :sass outside development)
changes.dockerfiles: unchanged; the `gem install nokogiri -v 1.18.10` pre-install lines stay

notes.sass_embedded_platform_gems: sass-embedded publishes aarch64-linux-gnu / x86_64-linux-gnu binary gems but every one of them (back to at least 1.97.0) declares required_ruby_version >= 3.2; only the generic `ruby` platform gem accepts Ruby 3.1. Bundler therefore locks the generic gem, whose ext/sass/Rakefile fetches the matching Dart Sass release at `bundle install` time (first by installing the platform gem, falling back to the GitHub release tarball; both attestation-verified). This needs network at install time, which the Docker builds already have for rubygems. Once Ruby is >= 3.2 the binary variants will be picked up with no Gemfile change.
notes.bundle_install_time: sassc 2.4.0 alone: ~26 s wall (gem install, arm64 dev container). sass-embedded 1.102.0 generic gem: ~5 s standalone, 0.6 s inside the image build. The whole `RUN bundle install` layer of Dockerfile.development (166 gems) now takes 19.6 s on this machine — less than the old sassc compile by itself. The before-image was fully layer-cached so no like-for-like wall time was available; CI (x86_64, slower) should show a larger absolute saving.
notes.dart_sass_warnings: Without quiet_deps a production assets:precompile emits 312 Dart Sass deprecation warnings (verbose count): import 92, global-builtin 100, color-functions 93, if-function 26, abs-percent 1. No slash-div warnings at all — bootstrap 4.6.2 already uses its divide() helper, so the predicted division noise did not occur. Only 5 of the 312 originate in the app (the five `@import` lines in application.scss); the other 307 are inside bootstrap 4.6.2.1's SCSS loaded through a Sprockets load path, which is exactly what quiet_deps hides. Decision: quiet_deps = true, `import` NOT added to silence_deprecations, so the 5 actionable warnings stay visible. Expected per-precompile output is now exactly 5 warnings.
notes.assets_precompile: RAILS_ENV=production: 50 files + 34 .gz written, exit 0, ~14 s. application.css 158,177 bytes (sass-compressed, 6 lines); application.js 2,650,722 bytes (terser; jquery, popper, bootstrap-sprockets, plotly, rails-ujs, turbolinks and the CoffeeScript output all in one bundle; rails-ujs ES6 arrow functions / const / let pass through untouched). public/assets and tmp/cache/assets were removed afterwards and are not committed.
notes.test_results: rubocop: 160 files, no offenses. rspec: 366 examples, 0 failures, 6 pending (pre-existing `Not yet implemented` view specs); the Capybara feature specs compile the SCSS/CoffeeScript through dartsass-sprockets in the test environment.
notes.bootstrap: bootstrap 4.6.2.1 depends only on autoprefixer-rails and popper_js, not on sassc-rails; removal was clean

held_back.sass_embedded: 1.102.0, not 1.106.1 — sass-embedded >= 1.103.0 requires Ruby >= 3.2 (we are on 3.1.7)
held_back.bootstrap: 4.6.2.1 retained; Dart Sass deprecation warnings from Bootstrap 4's SCSS stay (hidden by quiet_deps) until Bootstrap 5 (standing note)
